patch_description: This constructor retains the public interface while strengthening the search strategy around the successful square-grid-with-defect family. It uses several defect locations, asymmetric perturbations, staggered/hexagonal alternatives, exact fixed-center LP radius polishing, and a second joint SLSQP continuation started from the polished geometry. The nonlinear solver uses analytic Jacobians for all boundary and pair-clearance constraints. Final radii are always recomputed by LP and conservatively repaired, ensuring all circles remain in the unit square and non-overlapping.
